intro: A security drone drops from the ceiling on humming fans and swings its twin stunners toward you.
hit: The stunners crackle, and your muscles lock.
The drone tags you with a bolt that makes your teeth ache.
miss: The stunner bolts scorch the deck at your feet.
The drone's targeting light slides past you, then snaps back too late.
crit: Both stunners hit at once, and you hit the deck.
defeated: The drone sparks, spins and falls out of the air.
